senses.gloss:
Nāciketa, ‘connected with naciketas,’ is the title of a narrative (upākhyāna) in the kāṭhaka upaniṣad. The word is also applied as an epithet to a special fire in that upaniṣad and in the taittirīya upaniṣad.
Foot notes iii. 16.
i. 18; ii. 10.
i. 22, 11; 26, 3. Cf. Weber, Indische Studien, 3, 386. The native lexicographers give Nāchiketa and Nāciketu as synonyms of fire generally.
